description:
Activate Ignis by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Ignis enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Ignis.
Resolve the Ignis trigger, causing you to look at the top six cards of your library and put a land card from among them onto the battlefield.
If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Tireless Provisioner and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token. 
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the land that entered
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.
